phase_name: Migrate the live entries and verify end to end

objectives.description: Re-check git status for foreign modifications before any whole-tree action
Re-run install-sapience-mcp-session-hook.sh (dry-run then live) from the source store
Back up ~/.claude.json to a 0600 file before mutating
Enumerate and migrate all 6 token-bearing project entries via the installed writer
Assert the done condition by value (no SAPIENCE_TOKEN key, no matching string anywhere under .projects)
Re-confirm authentication with SAPIENCE_TOKEN absent (statusline + stdio initialize probes)
Run verify-sapience-mcp.sh against this repo and confirm check (b) passes
Confirm the verifier fails on a regression fixture with a named remedy
Remove the plaintext ~/.claude.json backup and confirm it is gone
Redeploy via deploy-headless.sh so the deployed tree stops diverging from the source store
Record completion of build items (1)-(6) against evidence, including item (6)'s inventory

notes: Phase 5 closes the plan: no project entry in ~/.claude.json holds the token (verified by value), the MCP server authenticates with SAPIENCE_TOKEN absent, verify-sapience-mcp.sh and its 58-case regression suite (including the sentinel-token negative control) pass, and the deployed tree is redeployed clean against the edited source store. A security finding was surfaced and recorded (kind: issue, severity: blocking) during this phase: setup-sapience-mcp.sh's own non-quiet 'diverges from the sanctioned shape' diagnostic printed the live token value in cleartext to this dispatch's Bash tool-output stream 6 times while migrating the 6 project entries -- a new transcript-exposure vector the task's own premise is meant to close. Flagged for the user's decision on token rotation and a redaction fast-follow; see issue log and user_decision field.
